correctness.rationale: The theorem concerns each n>=3 and arbitrary ordered k>=0 including repetitions. Every extensive isotone idempotent endomap has exactly the A_S, B_i, C normal forms: if f(0)=0, each atom maps to itself/top; if f(0)=top then f=C; if f(0)=a_i, monotonicity and idempotence enforce B_i. Compositions yield A_S A_T=A_(S cap T), B_i B_j=C for i≠j, C absorbing, and A_S B_i=B_i A_S=B_i exactly for i in S; otherwise A_S B_i=C but B_i A_S(0)=a_i, so they do not commute. Every commuting collection is contained in F_J for its occurring B_i, and F_J is maximal against any outside B_i (excluded by A_J) or A_S (excluded by B_j for omitted j in J). Therefore 2^n maximal families, sizes 2^(n-|J|)+|J|+1, all closed under composition. For an ordered k-tuple, fix the exactly occurring B-set J, force each B_j at least once and all A_S to contain J; inclusion-exclusion produces the given sum and EGF. For k=0 only J=empty contributes 1; k=2 yields 4^n+(n+2)2^n+(n+1)^2. Independent from-scratch enumeration of the original order axioms and composition graph for n=3,4,5 recovered 2^n maximal families and k=0,1,2,3,4 tuple counts (n=3: 1,12,120,1080,9240; n=4: 1,21,377,6237,100337; n=5: 1,38,1284,41192,1306896). These tests corroborate, not prove, the unbounded formulas.

The additional commutation criterion, 2^n maximal commuting families, their sizes, and all-arity tuple enumeration are not consequences of that unrefined count. value.rationale: The mathematical problem is natural: a set of idempotent extensive monotone operators can be applied in any order without changing the composite precisely when the operators pairwise commute. The diamond M_n is the simplest natural nondistributive lattice family of unbounded width. This theorem resolves its complete compatibility graph maximal-clique structure and counts all ordered commuting tuples for arbitrary k with repetitions, a genuinely structural and useful infinite-parameter invariant beyond the known isolated closure count. There is no claim of a general finite-lattice classification or downstream application.
residual_risks: Broader generalizations to other lattice families remain unproved.
Value is a narrow intrinsic structural classification, not a large general theory.

final_claim: For n>=3, the closure modalities on the labelled n-atom diamond M_n are A_S, B_i, C. The 2^n maximal pairwise-commuting families are exactly F_J={A_S:J subset S} union {B_i:i in J} union {C}, with size 2^(n-|J|)+|J|+1. Ordered commuting k-tuples with repetition for k>=0 have the stated inclusion-exclusion formula and EGF and T_n(2)=4^n+(n+2)2^n+(n+1)^2. Maximality is relative to collections of closure modalities only.
